The [[Gangster/Legends|thug]] [[Dors Stelikag]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] a '''gang''' of thugs.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] hired the gang to help his [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], during the<ref name="Choices" /> [[battle for Poln Major]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The thugs and the Chosen attempted to [[Death/Legends|murder]] the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]]; however, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Hand of Judgment]] group, and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] defeated Esva's forces and saved Ferrouz.<ref name="Choices" />
